result_summary.title: Sandbox SSO sync delays and partial bulk import failures
result_summary.description: We are seeing significant synchronization delays in our EU-Central sandbox environment with the SSO Integration Module. Additionally, when we attempt to run bulk imports, they appear to partially fail without clear error logs. We are unsure if this is an issue with the SSO module itself or if the underlying identity storage is causing the bottleneck, as both seem involved in the process. This affects 2 users currently.
